description: Jest's documented custom snapshot matcher (B23e, D128) under `jest.retryTimes(1)`: each test's first attempt takes its snapshots through jest-snapshot 30.5.2's `this.snapshotState.match` (and `fail`, for property matchers its value lacks) and then fails; the retry passes. jest-snapshot hands `match` and `fail` the matcher's `currentTestIdentity`, so jest-circus's `snapshotState.clear(test)` takes back the attempt's counters, counts and checked keys, and under `--ci` with the snapshots stored (a first local run, `before`) the retry's snapshots have the first attempt's keys and match. One file, one worker.
